data.one_liner: Simple customizable snackbar widget for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Snacky provides a lightweight snackbar implementation with minimal configuration. It supports custom widgets, automatic duration calculation, and optional dismissal controls.
use_when: Want a top or bottom snackbar without boilerplate
Require custom content or actions inside the snackbar
Need to cancel or queue snackbars programmatically
avoid_when: Building a full‑featured notification system with push support
Requiring extensive theming or complex animation pipelines
strengths: Minimal setup, just wrap MaterialApp with SnackyConfiguratorWidget
Highly configurable: duration, transition, location, padding, margin
weaknesses: Limited theming options compared to larger UI kits
Documentation focuses on basic usage; advanced customization may need digging into source
data.setup_notes: Wrap your MaterialApp with SnackyConfiguratorWidget and optionally add SnackyNavigationObserver to auto‑dismiss on navigation.

alternatives.name: fluttertoast
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides simple toast notifications with minimal API, suitable for quick alerts when full snackbar features are unnecessary.
